findings.basis: The reported Angular metric_segment/sql_part $sce.trustAsHtml injection is removed in this tagged source; official PR13670 escapes the values. The actual frontend is retained from the official 13.2.5 runtime; this does not assert arbitrary frontend XSS absence.

Historical dashboard/panel link injection implementation was replaced; actual link service sanitizes href through textUtil.sanitizeUrl. An explicitly configured disableSanitizeHtml opt-out is not asserted safe.

Text panel HTML is sanitized through sanitizeTextPanelContent in the modern React TextPanel unless the administrator explicitly enables disableSanitizeHtml; scope is the reported historical default-sanitization defect.

Affected legacy Angular table column-style renderer is absent; current official product source and retained frontend are 13.2.5. This is component-specific, not a blanket claim about all table panels.
Affected historical General panel links are replaced by the current link service, which sanitizes href through textUtil.sanitizeUrl; administrator opt-out is outside this conclusion.
CNA explicitly identifies panel_ctrl.ts before6.2.5; that implementation is absent. The current link service sanitizes URLs; title handling is the current typed frontend, not the old injected HTML.

Actual retained MySQL plugin constructs its DSN from separate values and percent-escapes the username colon, address closing parenthesis and database question mark; it never enables allowAllFiles. Those are the DSN delimiters required by the reported datasource-config injection. Actual plugin source ZIP dirhash matches the locked native module identity.

The exact vulnerable legacy table-old renderer patched by PR23816 is absent from the actual tagged source; retained official frontend is 13.2.5.

The OpenTSDB Angular query_ctrl/typeahead HTML implementation changed by PR24539 is absent in this tagged source; retained official 13.2.5 frontend uses the newer plugin architecture. Not a claim that all OpenTSDB server responses are safe.
The Elasticsearch/testdata Angular editor templates and Graph series-overrides controller patched by PR25401 are absent from actual tagged source; retained frontend is official13.2.5.

GetByLogin explicitly queries email first when @ occurs, and queries login only if no email user was found. That prevents an attacker username shadowing the victim email, exactly the official regression contract; no claim that LoginConflict itself cross-checks email against username.
Current shared snapshot preparation replaces originalUrl with a generated relative path derived from a validated dashboard UID; supplied external destination is not retained.

Actual core is official tagged13.2.5 ce471, rebuilt only for pinned dependencies; the private pseudoversion is not the product version. Grafana CNA product scope is Grafana Enterprise only, with defaultStatus unaffected and four affected ranges ending9.4.16/9.5.11/10.0.7/10.1.3. Actual build is public OSS ce471, default non-enterprise build tags, base grafana/grafana rather than grafana-enterprise; it does not contain the affected Enterprise RBAC implementation.

Actual native alerting module DingDing schema marks url Secure:true and Protected:true; its reader decrypts the secure url. This is the precise secret-field fix, not a comparison of Grafana product13 with Go pseudo1.9.2.

Both actual retained native plugin sources contain the official guards: Loki parses and path.Cleans constructed resource path and enforces /loki/api/v1 prefix; Tempo rejects . and .. tag path segments. Official source ZIP hashes match each compiled plugin module Sum. Core version alone was not used to clear this moved-plugin defect.

Current contact-point update checks Protected fields before converting/persisting settings; HasUpdateProtected permits legitimate writers, otherwise changed protected fields require AuthorizeUpdateProtected. Actual source matches official daffe fix contract.

Actual SQL allowlist walker recursively checks SetOp OrderBy/With/Limit and Select Window omitted by upstream walk, and rejects lock/INTO fields explicitly. This is the official fb733 fix; conclusion does not depend on assuming sqlExpressions disabled.

Permission updates now invalidate both regular-user and service-account permission-cache keys in clearUserPermissionCache, called after single and batch updates. Matches official fb733 fix for token-mint revocation.

Actual RevokeInvite loads invite metadata and requires currentOrgID==invite.OrgID OR globalGrafanaAdmin before updateTempUserStatus; otherwise403. This directly repairs the CNA cross-org invite-revocation condition. No fabricated fixed-version claim is made from the noFixed scan record.
Current correlations SQL restricts correlation.org_id to the authenticated org and datasource joins use that same org; the legacy OR org_id=0 fallback removed by e702 is absent.

limitations: This facts table is not a signed verified profile or final whole-subject review. Final frozen profile and full all-severity scan/inventory/independent review binding remain necessary.
